description: This source file defines a Java class ControlActivationEventListener which implements HttpSessionActivationListener. It listens to session passivation and activation events, logging session state changes and updating session counters.

classes.name: ControlActivationEventListener
classes.description: Implements HttpSessionActivationListener to track session activation/passivation events, logging and updating counters.

methods.name: sessionWillPassivate
methods.description: Called when an HttpSession is passivated; increments the passivation count and logs the event.

methods.name: sessionDidActivate
methods.description: Called when an HttpSession is activated; increments the activation count and logs the event.

methods.name: showSessionId
methods.description: Returns the session ID if configured to show session IDs in logs; otherwise indicates session ID is hidden.
